statement: ∀ A B P : ℝ, 0 ≤ P → min (3*A*P) (3*B*P) = 3*P*min A B
proof:
intro A B P hP
rcases le_total A B with h | h
· rw [min_eq_left h, min_eq_left (by nlinarith)]
  ring
· rw [min_eq_right h, min_eq_right (by nlinarith)]
  ring
